figurative_meaning_en: The initial or early stage of a cold
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কাঁচা সর্দি লেগেছে, এখনো জ্বর আসেনি।
শীতের শুরুতে কাঁচা সর্দি হওয়া সাধারণ।
example_sentences_in_english: He has a raw cold; the fever hasn't started yet.
It's common to get a raw cold at the beginning of winter.
note: Refers to the mild, beginning symptoms of the common cold in everyday Bengali usage.
